answers.answer: Employees with 0 – 3 years of service may work remotely one day per week (Wednesday or Thursday), while those with 3+ years of service may work remotely two days per week (Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday) [1].

If you commute 2–3 days per week, the company contributes $75 per month toward your commute [1, 2]. This applies to U.S.-based employees who are assigned to and commute to the New York office at least two days per week, and you must elect to apply the contribution to either transit benefits or parking benefits [3, 4].
The standard adaptation (probation) period for a new hire is 3 months, but for Affordable Housing and Property Tax Analysts it is 1 month [1, 2].
Your profile photo must have a solid neutral background, with gray preferred [1].
The standard working hours for the Costa Rica team are 7.00 am – 4.00 pm Costa Rica Time, with a 1 hour lunch break [1].
Advanced (C1–C2) English classes are held on Monday & Wednesday [1]. Schedules may be adjusted based on participation and business needs [1].

Any non-exempt employee who works overtime is compensated at one and one-half times (1.5) their normal hourly wage for all time worked in excess of 40 hours each week, unless otherwise required by law [1].

You receive a grant of 40 hours of paid safe and sick time at the start of each calendar year (January 1 through December 31) [1]. You may carry over unused safe and sick leave to the following calendar year, but you can only use up to 40 hours in each calendar year [2].

For employees in the Affordable Housing Processing Team, salary reviews are conducted every 6 months [1]. The Hiring Manager tracks each employee's 6-month review cycle and initiates the review requests on time [1].
cited: ai_course/HR-Salary Review Process via BambooHR_ A Structured Overview-071126-121239.pdf#9

answers.answer: Employees in the EU Team are entitled to five (5) Floating Holidays per calendar year [1]. They may take no more than one (1) paid holiday day off within a 30-day period, must give a minimum of four (4) daysʼ notice, and the days do not roll over to the next calendar year [2].

During their first three years (0–3 years of service), US employees accrue 1.77 hours weekly, which equals 92 hours (11.5 days) per year [1, 2]. This replaces the previous entitlement of 80 hours (10 days) per year [3].

Employees in Ukraine are eligible for twenty-four (24) calendar days of paid annual leave [1]. The paid time off overview for the EU team (full-time) likewise lists 24 days of vacation, accrued on a calendar year [2].
I only answer questions about working at the company. Please contact HR with this one.

Form PFL-DC-120 is the Paid Family Leave Discrimination Complaint, which an employee may file with the Workers' Compensation Board if the Company does not comply with the employee's request for reinstatement within 30 days [1]. Once the complaint is received, the Board assembles the employee's case and schedules a preliminary hearing in front of a workers' compensation law judge [1].

The employment contract is prepared in Vchasno by the Head of RO or HR once the candidate accepts the offer in writing [1, 2]. All new employees must sign their employment contract via Vchasno prior to their official start date [3, 4].
